scope: Independent read-only normals, contact and native-lighting audit. No runtime or asset writes.

runtime_contract.normal_coordinate_system: PNG OpenGL tangent X right, Y image up, Z toward viewer. Upright world normal is [PNG.X, PNG.Z, PNG.Y].
runtime_contract.mirror: DrawOpts.flip negates world normal X exactly once. Source columns remain unmirrored for support lookup; sprite raster mirrors both source and anchor.
runtime_contract.masks: Albedo alpha is authoritative. Sprite surfaces and caster masks use the exact accepted native pose and emission mask.
runtime_contract.support: Per-column native support registered before normal-height stamping. Hero body-only authored spans radius4/depth4; Sprout4/3; Imp4.5/3; Beetle fullwidth/8; Wisp4.5/2; Hound fullwidth/4; Totem fullwidth/5. Collision radii unchanged.
runtime_contract.afterimages: Silhouette/ghost sprites do not register normal receivers or opaque surface casters. They retain captured cell, anchor and flip.
runtime_contract.sorting: World actors sort by unchanged feet Y. Foreground reveal is pose-relative; physical shadow opacity remains separate from visual reveal.
runtime_contract.motivated_lights: Blade, crest, flame, ember and mouth sample actual live emissive native pixels; no invented body lantern.

review_findings_sent.resolution: Compile frozen production harness with GLINT_ASSETS set to the full matched candidate or installed asset root.
